title: Grid System Content Pipeline
description: How map_data.json becomes a 3D scene: JsonMapLoader → GridSystem → Components → Instantiation.

nodes.label: GridStructureComponent builds geometry
nodes.detail: Floors, walls, heights from structure layer. cube_size and gutter from config.

nodes.label: GridUtilitiesComponent places utilities
nodes.detail: Spawn points, teleporters, ramps, transport cubes, labels from utilities layer.

nodes.label: ArtifactRegistry instantiates artifacts
nodes.detail: lookup_name → scene path → load(path).instantiate() → position on grid → apply_grid_config()

summary: map_data.json → 3 layers (structure, utilities, interactables) → GridSystem components → instantiate artifacts from registry.
